research_question: Did Phase160 fail because exact bodies were too specific even though its machine-selected non-chain topology productions transferred structurally?

training_scope.productions: only Phase160 selected non-chain topology productions
training_scope.occurrences: training motifs under each selected production

typed_anti_unification.topology: preserve the exact learned topology production
typed_anti_unification.operator_slot: preserve a target only if identical at that node position in every training occurrence; otherwise create a position-specific operator hole
typed_anti_unification.argument_recipe_slot: preserve canonical args and kwargs only if identical at that node position in every training occurrence; otherwise create a position-specific recipe hole
typed_anti_unification.type_relations: for every pair of node-output positions, preserve equality only if their exact tensor types are equal in every training occurrence; all other types are independently bound typed holes
typed_anti_unification.output_boundary: preserve exact output indices from the learned topology
typed_anti_unification.template_selected: at least one operator or argument-recipe hole and at least two training families

controls.candidate_only_definition: template match under a non-chain production whose exact body digest is absent from Phase160 heldout exact matches

primary_endpoints.heldout_template_matches: number of bound and byte-identically reconstructed heldout bodies
primary_endpoints.candidate_only_template_matches: template matches absent from the Phase160 exact library
primary_endpoints.candidate_only_template_nodes: nodes in candidate-only template matches not covered by exact-body, chain, or fixed controls
primary_endpoints.families_reached: distinct heldout families with candidate-only template matches

causal_tests.weaken_type_equality: hostile ledger must be rejected rather than increasing matches

decision_rule.positive: at least one candidate-only template match reconstructs byte-identically and covers a heldout node unreachable by all three controls; two implementations and all hostile/resource gates pass
decision_rule.valid_negative: complete bounded execution passes but no candidate-only node is reached
decision_rule.infrastructure_failure: implementations disagree, reconstruction is not byte-identical, hostile checks fail, or resource limits fail

must_cover: claim inflation to concrete reuse or prospective
